content:
Quick update on Ultra-Dex (v6.0.0):

**What we shipped:**
- Multi-provider routing (14 providers)
- Cost optimization (up to 50% savings)
- VSCode extension
- Plugin system

**Key insight from users:**
"I was paying $300/month for OpenAI alone. This cut it to $120." - Beta user

**What changed:**
Switched from LangChain-first to direct API integration for better control

**Looking ahead:**
Auto-routing based on cost/quality tradeoffs

What's your experience with LLM cost optimization?

#AI #Startups
